lead7: Lead month 7 is not in the CDS monthly product (leads 1–6). Forecast: the same SEAS5 run's sub-daily fields (seasonal-original), averaged over the month the way the monthly product is (instantaneous fields: every step after 00 UTC on the 1st up to and including 00 UTC on the 1st of the next month, as a lead-6 test against the monthly product fixed it; accumulations: the month's total over its seconds). Hindcast reference: the same 1993–2016 hindcast, 25 members, from the daily copy of the C3S archive on AWS (instantaneous fields, interpolated to the CDS grid) and the CDS sub-daily hindcast (accumulations, 50 hPa height, 30/50 hPa wind). Skill is lower at lead 7; it goes through the same calibration and trend handling as leads 1–6, and the same tests where a product has one (the teleconnection skill test, the tercile maps' signal test, the anomaly and change maps' Welch test).

index_meta.label: Relative Niño-3.4
index_meta.note: Niño-3.4 minus the 20°S–20°N tropical mean, RONI-scaled by calendar month

index_meta.label: Trans-Niño index
index_meta.note: standardised Niño-1+2 minus standardised Niño-4: positive means east-loaded

index_meta.label: PDO
index_meta.note: North Pacific EOF projection on the NCEI scale, global mean removed

index_meta.label: AMO (relative)
index_meta.note: North Atlantic 0–60°N minus the 60°S–60°N global mean

maps.test: Shaded only where significant (Welch t-test, false-discovery rate 0.10 over the map)
maps.chg_untested: No change maps for this issue: the September issue's stored forecast or its start month's hindcast carries no spread, so a change cannot be tested.
